research_notes: This domain has 26 roles, copied from the uploaded careerData.json.
Credential type labels distinguish proctored professional certifications, private-provider certifications, course-based certificates, and free learning resources.
There is no single universally accepted LLMOps certification; role-aligned vendor certifications and production projects are stronger evidence than course completion alone.
Prices can vary by country, tax, promotions, and exam version. Unknown prices are marked unconfirmed rather than guessed.
AWS MLA-C02 is in beta as of the research date, with USD 75 beta pricing; check current exam status before booking.
Microsoft AI-300 is directly aligned with MLOps and GenAIOps on Azure; NVIDIA NCP-AIO is advanced and experience-heavy.
Role mappings are relevance suggestions, not guarantees of job qualification.
This is a curated research batch, not an exhaustive list of every possible credential.
